5.6.10 Rte_Read Purpose: Performs an “explicit” read on a sender-receiver communication data element with “data” semantics (swImplPolicy != queued). By compatibility, the port may also have a ParameterInterface or a NvDataInterface. The Rte_Read API is used for explicit read by argument.
